items.headline: an AI chatbot looks the answer up on the internet.
items.hook: Myth: an AI chatbot looks the answer up on the internet.
points: Reality: a language model writes likely text from patterns it learned in training. Some products add search or document lookup on top.
So when a tool does not show sources, treat the answer as a draft to check.
